results.evidence: All 26 top-level unit tests passed (0 failed or skipped). Each of the 25 product unit-test catalog entries was matched to its named passing TAP result; the example CLI test is intentionally outside this catalog. The complete desktop smoke passed, establishing all assertions in its ten focused catalog groups and the full integration entry. All 36 named outcomes are therefore established by execution, not inferred from test names. Structural/link validation and whitespace checks passed. Inspected assertions against exact linked description passages; gaps and limits are recorded in docs/test-catalog-audit.md. Impact frontier has 20 examined descriptions, no missing decisions and no unmapped regions. Unit log: /private/tmp/stratic-catalog-unit.txt. Desktop log: /private/tmp/stratic-catalog-desktop.txt. Before/after snapshots match.
